description: Tones down a loud, aggressive or overstimulating design: lower saturation and contrast, lighter weights, fewer competing elements and calmer motion, keeping hierarchy and quality. Use when the user says a design is too bold, loud, garish, busy or overwhelming, or wants a calmer, more refined look. Not for removing features or controls from a cluttered screen (use ui-simplify).
